h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madanapalle

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Madanapalle

items.pText: Madanapalle sits on a plateau in the Rayalaseema region, cooler than the plains below it and surrounded by farmland and hills. The area is home to residential schools as well as day schools, and a boarding campus uses its playground very differently from a city school. FunPlay Systems designs and manufactures outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, about 880 km away, and sends it by road.

On a residential campus, children play in the evenings and on weekends as well as at break, often in mixed-age groups with less adult supervision. We plan for that from the start. Send us the campus plan, the age range of your students and photos of the ground, and we will suggest equipment and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Boarding students use the same equipment for years, so they need pieces that stay interesting. Structures that invite group games and imagination work well here. Our
collection, designed by our own team, includes play stations such as
that groups of children explore together.

Place the playground within view of a hostel or staff quarters, and light the path to it if children use it after sunset. The plateau climate is milder than much of Andhra Pradesh. Rain and sun still wear surfaces, though, so we use galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts with a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 880 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What playground equipment suits a residential school?
items.a: Group play structures and climbers that hold older children's interest over several years, alongside a separate area for younger students. We plan both on one layout drawing.

items.q: Can you deliver to a campus outside Madanapalle town?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment by road from Vasai. Let us know about the approach road to the campus so the delivery vehicle can reach the site.
Our own installation team or a dealer in south India. We choose grouted or self-standing installation depending on the ground at your site.
